per-preset profile assignment with explicit NODE_ENV and required variables

summary: Finite verification jobs now receive a complete environment resolved independently from the profile selected for the managed development server. Unit presets default to the clean unit profile with NODE_ENV=test, while build, lint, and typecheck presets use the clean tooling profile.

A test profile may opt into a specifically named server profile, add literal variables, and declare required variables. The selected server profile is never inherited implicitly, and controller-owned ambient variables outside the fixed system allowlist do not reach test children.

Applied environment mode, profile, inherited server profile, and variable names are retained with each run without persisting secret values. Test-profile mutation results are redacted at the service boundary so REST, MCP, and dashboard responses expose names rather than values.
title: Isolated finite verification environments from server profiles
validation: Regression tests cover the WinPath QA profile leak, exact child environment names, independence from the selected server profile, explicit named inheritance, required variables, NODE_ENV defaults, persistence, REST, MCP, and redaction of mutation results.
